system.description: Also known as Zeta Reticulans, the Greys, are very intelligent beings with a natural hang for exploration and research. The humanoid aliens with the grey skintone were the first to make contact with humanity. They are known for their wits, often acting quick and unseen. Greys can communicate telepathically. They also have a history of being accused of abducting other species’ members.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist
